title: Fixed-size 3x3 Math with std::array, pair & structured bindings
hints: `Mat3 C{};` value-initialises every entry to 0. A bare `Mat3 C;` holds garbage doubles, just like a C array.
matmul: `C[i][j] += A[i][k] * B[k][j]` over k. Copying `std::array` is a value copy, so `matmul(A, A)` aliasing is fine if you accumulate into a fresh local `C`.
det: expand along the first row (rule of Sarrus / cofactors).
normalize: `return {Vec3{x/n, y/n, z/n}, n};` builds the pair. Return `{Vec3{}, 0.0}` when n is 0. Callers write `auto [u, n] = normalize(v);`. For minMaxEntry, return `std::make_tuple(...)`.
